maddeler.e:
أقطوطي (form XII)
# أَقْطَوْطِي (ʔaqṭawṭī) /ʔaq.tˤaw.tˤiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْطَوْطَى (iqṭawṭā)
# أَقْطَوْطِيَ (ʔaqṭawṭiya) /ʔaq.tˤaw.tˤi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْطَوْطَى (iqṭawṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
